text: Regular spelling changes, old → new. Second slot: box-cross → wide; seed and arrow unchanged. First slot: tree+loop → tree+dot+loop; mbox-pointbelow → box-curl+dot; box-curl → mbox-saw; wave+curl → wave; mbox-cross → door (twice) or door+dot (once); mbox-cross+loop → door+loop (twice) or seed+arch (once). Unchanged: box-curl+dot, hornbox(+dot), box-point, mbox-sweep, lamp, egg, fishhook, tree (mostly).
